sn7.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn7.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aggika-bhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa sappinā pāyāso sannihito hoti || ||
sn7.8:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi ||
sn7.8:2.2: Rājagahe sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena aggika-bhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 4.
sn7.8:2.3: Addasā kho aggika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ ||
sn7.8:9.4: khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī ti || || 8.
sn7.8:10.1: Evam vutte aggika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.8:10.3: Aññantaro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahatam ahosīti || || 1.
